profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have strong technical, leadership and interpersonal skills, combined with creativity and 30 years of experience.  I have software architecture and hands-on programming experience with C/C++, Java, and Python.    I have worked in a variety of domains from Visual Simulation to Telephony to Sea Vessel Structural Analysis to Commodities Trading and Space.  I also have experience leading teams ranging from 2 to 25 people.  I enjoy the Colorado outdoors with my family when I am not reading, playing with Arduino devices, or setting up automation.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Technical lead of 5 developers. Work with leadership and my System Engineer to breakdown EPICs into tasks and stories in JIRA and to keep a steady prioritized backlog for the team to work.  Coordinate and present on technical topics as well as architecture and designs changes.  Also present to our customers at demos and customer-facing meetings.
* Work with our System Engineer and UI Designer to define details of expected behavior and look and feel for front end / UI development to ensure it is documented in our team's JIRA tickets before they start development
* Developing backend microservices in Java 17 with the Spring Framework including Spring Boot and deploying them using Docker, Kubernetes and Helm
* Developing our Vue.js version 3 front end including creating new components and Pinia stores and populating the JSON front end data classes from REST calls and Websockets to the backend Java services.
* Created and demo'ed a prototype of changes to move to GItOps deployments using ArgoCD and will create JIRA tickets to captures tasks needed to complete the migration
* Created and demo'ed a 3D visualization prototype using Vue 3 and Cesium that loaded 3d models from files and animated them with user interaction within a browser
* Automated all of our new developer setup into a single bash script.  
* Updating gitlab-ci.yml and supporting files for pipelines

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developing microservices with REST APIs in Python3 with PyTest for Unit Testing
•	 Using Bandit, Black, Pylint, isort, Commitizen and MyPy in Gitlab pre-commit-hook for code linting and commit message formatting
•	 Using Poetry for dependency management and building
•	 Using Gitlab for source-control and CI/CD pipelines that test on every merge and auto-increment the microservice version on mergebased on the Commitizen message prefix.
•	 Using RKE2 (Kubernetes) running on AWS EC2 instances to run microservices.
•	 Using ArgoCD for GitOps deployment of versioned / branched instances of services (to test a new version, rollback, etc.) with parent objects for maintaining "released" / "official" versions of services.
•	 Developed Terraform infrastructure to deploy RDS, S3 and DynamoDB configuration and apply updates using 'init', 'plan' and 'apply' (amongst other commands)
•	 Using Helm to define Deployments, StatefulSets and CronJobs for microservice containers, initContainers and "Completion SideCar" containers and related Kubernetes objects (secrets, configmaps, services, PersistentVolumeClaims, etc.).  The "Completion SideCar" containers monitor shared mounted directories via inotifywait and then upload the result files to an AWS S3 bucket
•	 Incorporated external containers into our Kubernetes cluster and connected them via input / output in AWS S3 buckets
•	 On-call support for existing software using K9s, ElasticSearch and Rancher to monitor service, network and node state.
•	 Tracking work using JIRA and documenting design and how-tos via Confluence

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Providing full-stack Java development for the Intelligent Software Systems division of Raytheon BBN
•	Submitted proposals ranging from AR multi-user environments and headsets with live streaming of data to cyber analysis and remediation tools. 
•	Working on Kustomize configuration for deploying containers to a Kubernetes cluster.
•	Writing a multithreaded Message Broker in Java to translate between 2 very large systems at scale. 
•	Defined and schedule while leading team to publish hardened Docker containers to Iron Bank.
•	Setup publishing and pulling of packages to / from YUM / APT repositories in Artifactory using RockyOS and Ubuntu respectively.
•	Refactored almost 200 classes to create new Spring microservice using Spring and Apache Ignite 
•	Presented at the 2nd annual AI in Contested Space Workshop.
•	Organized 2 presentations as co-chair of technology group on Rust and on Web Assembly (WASM)  
•	Organizing Symposium Plenary Speakers and 2 DevSecOps workshops across RTX.
•	Wrote Android application using WGS84 calculations and another using ZXing QR Code library.  
•	Improved Gradle files on project to allow proper parallel builds resulting in reducing build time by over 66%. 
•	Create and track Data Message Stats and provide REST API call via Spring WebFlux interface.  Also used Apache Ignite to synchronize statistics across servers via IgniteQueue, IgniteSet and IgniteAtomicReference. 
•	Upgraded existing software deployment and automated install from PostgreSQL 10 to 15 for RedHat, RockyOS and a Debian-based Docker container. 
•	Incorporated PGPool for PostgreSQL DB data replication and high availability.
•	Using AWS for functional / integrated testing and VirtualBox for local testing of deployment on various OSes.  
•	Designed microservice, CI/CD architecture for new program.
•	Setup an API Gateway microservice using JHipster and OpenAPI, for API-first development, with Spring Boot and Spring WebFlux with WebClient
positions.insights: Skills: Java 17 · Gradle · Apache Ignite · Android Development · Kubernetes · Spring Framework · Docker · PostgreSQL · Artifactory · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Swagger API · JHipster · Open API · Spring Webflux · Java · Software Architecture · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · RockyOS · Ubuntu · Team Leadership · VirtualBox · JAXB

positions.title: Automation Architect / Lead
positions.description:
• Led a team of 2 developers to implement automation and modernize a large program with over 14 new tools including the Gradle, Atlassian Suite, Cloudbees Jenkins and Artifactory resulting in 80% less build configuration and over 50% less build time saving an average of 3.8 hours per day per developer.  
•	Used Value Stream Mapping (VSM) analysis to focus efforts and “strangler” architecture approach to changes. 
•	Defined Guiding Principles and Design for implementing the new tools and guided my team on any questions.
•	Wrote idempotent install scripts for the Atlassian Suite, Artifactory and Cloudbees.
•	Setup Cloudbees / Jenkins CI pipelines in Groovy for each Gradle project with code coverage metrics for both Java and C++ using Jacoco (Java) and gcov with gcovr).
•	Used Cucumber to automate our smoke tests resulting in 20x faster execution time.
•	Developed a migration script for data from IBM ClearCase to Atlassian Bitbucket  
•	Presented at internal symposiums on “Evolving Architecture for DevSecOps” as well as “Lessons learned from a DevSecOps transformation of an established program”.
•	Completed Raytheon Certified Architect training including DODAF, TOGAF and Zachman Frameworks including Level 1 Zachman Framework certification

positions.title: Automation Architecture / DevOps / Platform and Software Automation Lead
positions.description:
•	Wrote a Java program to programmatically analyze performance on our CI pipeline using the Jenkins REST API and the Jackson XML library. 
•	Wrote python scripts to calculate which packages to automatically deploy from Artifactory to a staging location for use by Chef.
•	Presented at the JFrog swampUP 2018 conference.
•	Presented on Architecture and DevOps at the 2017 AllDayDevOps conference
•	Provided DevOps methodology education and encouraging adoption of DevOps practices with our customer and throughout our large program organization
•	Defined the end-to-end automation and deployment architecture for on-prem and cloud environments with true release assembly, promotion and semantic versioning. 
•	Met with the president of IIS and several vice-presidents about process streamlining opportunities across several programs

positions.title: Lead SW Architect
positions.description:
•	Led a team of 5 systems architects and 6 software architects across the program to identify architecture gaps and define our unified architecture approach for the system
•	Presented on Architecture and DevOps at the SATURN 2017 conference.  Presentation available on YouTube @  https://youtu.be/bzVrt__Vmgc 
•	Defined and presented a technology roadmap to our customer containing proposed short-term, mid-term and long-term technology updates that resulted in increased Award Fee. 
•	Defined the Build and Deploy baseline architecture for the entire system including the use of Gradle, Artifactory and other technologies

positions.title: Enterprise and SW Architect  / Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Automation Lead of 3-4 developers implementing Continuous Integration using JUnit, CppUnit, JaCoCo (code coverage), gcovr (code coverage) and Jenkins  
•	Presented Automated Test Patterns and Anti-Patterns training across Raytheon. 
•	Re-designed and re-implemented our build system to allow fully parallelized builds and incremental builds taking our full building time from 6 hours to 15 minutes with no HW changes 
•	Co-chair for Software Engineering technology group and mentor to junior engineers 
•	Certified in Raytheon's Software Architecture Program (SWAP) with training on CMU’s SEI, Bredemeyer’s VAP, DODAF, Zachman and TOGAF frameworks.   
•	Technical Lead of 5 developer team porting our SW from AIX to Linux.  
•	Defined CI migration plan and evolutionary architecture with common definitions and major milestones using new tools like Jenkins, JUnit, and CppUnit 
•	On own time and resources, developed Android 3D mobile app using the OpenGL ES API in the Android SDK for 3D Graphics rendering. 
•	Worked on a multi-company team of Enterprise Architects to design the architecture for the SOA modernization of a very large system of systems (SoS) using DODAF and UML 2.0.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Wrote and tested multithreaded software to perform calibration and validation analysis on space data using Java and Hibernate Derby DB, and Junit with several design patterns (Singleton, Decorator, Façade, Proxy, Command, Factory, etc.)
·	Implemented the system as several thin clients that communicate with one of several 24x7 servers, using Java RMI.
·	Used Java Serialization, Xerces SAX and Xerces DOM for loading/saving data objects from/to disk.
·	Implemented an extensive, data-type driven GUI framework based on the Java Swing API
·	Cross-team lead for development phase in addition to my regular development responsibilities.

positions.title: Lead Software Programmer
positions.description:
•	Led team of 2-5 developers to architect (using OOA/D and UML) and implement a large-scale trading application using Java, Sybase, EJBs, and Jakarta Struts on BEA Weblogic App Servers. Also used JINI and XML to interface with the legacy trading application written in 2 million lines of C source code. 
•	On own time and resources, developed Java3D modeler featuring a scene graph / hierarchy, full lighting and texture mapping, as well as custom Extrusion and Surface of Revolution dialogs for defining complex shapes.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Java · UML · OOAD · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · Team Leadership · Java Native Interface (JNI) · XML · Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB) · WebLogic · Solaris · Oracle Database

positions.title: Software Engineer (contractor)
positions.description:
•	Wrote code using Microsoft Visual C++, MFC and OpenGL to graphically represent the structural integrity of marine facilities and vessels on a Windows 95 system. 
•	Also wrote C++ code to graphically model relative wave-directional strengths across the world and their structural effects on various marine vessels.
positions.insights: Skills: OpenGL · C++ · Microsoft Visual Studio C++

positions.title: Software Engineer (contractor)
positions.description: •	Worked on a team to design and code intelligent behaviors for the Opposing Forces group in the ModSAF strategic warfare simulation program.   Used calculus and trigonometric functions in C++ to implement real world physical and behavioral models (i.e. atmospheric conditions, gravity, visibility, group formation, acceleration, etc.)
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Visual Simulation · Game Physics · Solaris

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Wrote Fault Management software in C++ for large-scale telephony hardware systems
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Solaris · Object Oriented Database · Telephony

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote C++ classes on the SGI IRIX platform using Iris Performer, OpenGL, and Coryphaeus'​ EasyScene to represent entities and their underlying behavior within the simulation including responding to various conditions and the actions of other entities within the simulation. 
•	Designed and implemented an "intelligent car"​ in C++, which can drive itself given only a destination to drive to. The "simulated car"​ will calculate the best route, slow down in a turn, decide how much to turn, only go "off-road" if necessary with a minimum of information about the area. 
•	Wired a serial cable for use between a joystick and 422 serial port on an SGI Onyx and wrote corresponding driver in C.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · OpenGL · a* pathfinding · Silicon Graphics · Unix · Unix ioctl library · Unix Driver

positions.title: Full Service Network (FSN) Administrator (Internship)
positions.description: •	Administered over 30 SGI Challenge servers delivering realtime multimedia content to over 4000 homes.

positions.title: Systems Engineer (Internship)
positions.description: •	Assembled, configured, and loaded workstations, IRIX OS, and software for customers.

positions.title: Programmer (internship)
positions.description: •	Wrote C++ code and created various 3D models for DIS (distributed interactive simulation) used by the US military for the visual simulation of tactical warfare.
